## Slice 2 ticket 32 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 32); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Port cross-account provisioning, the customer computers CloudFormation stack, image and snapshot-bucket helpers, and POST self-setup/cross-account-role. The CloudFormation template asset moves to infra/.

## Kind
mechanical-port: the Python source below is the specification. Keep its structure, names (camelCase), branches and messages. Do not redesign anything.

## Branch and commit
```text
git fetch origin
git switch -c ts/32-customer-account-provisioning-and-self-s origin/develop
...work, then...
git add <only the files listed under Files>
git commit -m "feat(conversation): customer account provisioning and self-setup

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -u origin ts/32-customer-account-provisioning-and-self-s
```
Do NOT open a pull request; the orchestrator opens it. Commit messages contain no emojis.

## Exported interface and error behavior
Route `POST /api/orgs/{tenant}/self-setup/cross-account-role`. Customer account ids are never written to docs or wiki (AGENTS.md); fixtures use placeholders such as 111122223333.

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.
